_comment: Project context, versioned and shared with the team. Both agents and the tools in
mcu/tools/ read this file. Anything here must be true for every clone of the
repository: board, chip, interface, recovery path, build parameters.
Machine-specific values (tool paths, probe serial numbers, serial ports,
operation_mode) go in local.json, which is gitignored. `flow diagnose` reports
values sitting in the wrong file.
